info.name: Tickr API v1.0
info.description:
# Tickr Event Ticketing Platform API

Complete API collection for the Tickr Tunisian online ticketing platform.

## Base URL
- **Local Development**: `http://localhost:3000/api`
- **Staging**: `https://staging.tickr.com/api`
- **Production**: `https://api.tickr.com/api`

## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT Bearer authentication. Use the Login endpoint to obtain tokens.

## Modules
- **Authentication** — Register, login, token management
- **Users** — Profile management (self + admin)
- **Events** — Event lifecycle (create, publish, cancel)
- **Ticket Types** — Event ticket type CRUD
- **Tickets** — Reserve, confirm, transfer, check-in
- **Orders** — Create orders, process payments, refunds
- **Notifications** — Send, list, manage preferences
- **Analytics** — Event metrics, dashboards, reports, export

## Getting Started
1. Register a new user (Register User)
2. Login to get access token (Login)
3. Token auto-saved to collection variables
4. Use protected endpoints directly

request.description:

**Categories:**
CONCERT, CONFERENCE, SPORT, THEATER, WORKSHOP, FESTIVAL, EXHIBITION, NETWORKING, COMEDY, OTHER

**Sort Fields:**
createdAt, updatedAt, startDate, endDate, title, totalCapacity, soldTickets, publishedAt

Search events by title.

**Required:** `q` parameter with search term.

Get events filtered by category.

**Valid Categories:**
CONCERT, CONFERENCE, SPORT, THEATER, WORKSHOP, FESTIVAL, EXHIBITION, NETWORKING, COMEDY, OTHER
Get upcoming events (events starting in the future).
Get detailed information about a specific event, including ticket types.

Create a new event.

**Note:** Events are created in DRAFT status. Use 'Publish Event' to make them visible.

**Categories:** CONCERT, CONFERENCE, SPORT, THEATER, WORKSHOP, FESTIVAL, EXHIBITION, NETWORKING, COMEDY, OTHER
Update an existing event. Only the event owner or admin can update.

Publish a draft event.

**Requirements:**
- Event must be in DRAFT status
- Event must have at least one active ticket type

Cancel an event. A reason is required.

All ticket holders will be notified.

Get all events for an organizer.

**Status filter:** DRAFT, PUBLISHED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED

Upload an image for an event.

**Formats:** JPEG, PNG, WebP
**Max size:** 5MB

item.name: 🎫 Tickets
item.description: Ticket reservation, management, check-in, and transfer endpoints

request.description:
Reserve tickets for an event. Creates a 15-minute reservation hold.

**Note:** Must complete payment within the reservation window or tickets will expire.

Confirm reserved tickets after payment.

Transitions RESERVED tickets to CONFIRMED status. Typically called by the Payments module after successful payment.

Get the authenticated user's tickets with optional pagination and status filter.

**Status values:** RESERVED, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED, CHECKED_IN, EXPIRED

Get detailed information about a specific ticket.

Accessible by ticket owner or the event organizer.

Download the ticket PDF.

Redirects (302) to a signed S3 URL. Only the ticket owner can download.

Transfer a ticket to another user by email.

**Limits:** Max 3 transfers per ticket.
**Effect:** Generates a new QR code and assigns to the new owner.

Check in a ticket at venue entrance using QR code.

**Requires:** ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.
**Time window:** Event start - 1 hour to Event end.

Duplicate check-in attempts are rejected and logged as security alerts.

Get aggregated check-in statistics for an event.

**Requires:** ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.

**Returns:** Total tickets, checked-in count, rate, breakdown by ticket type.

item.name: 💳 Orders & Payments
item.description: Order creation, payment processing, and refund management

request.description:
Create a new order for tickets.

**Flow:**
1. Create order (PENDING)
2. Process payment (redirect to gateway)
3. Webhook confirms (order becomes PAID)

**Note:** Orders expire after 30 minutes if not paid.
List the current user's orders with pagination.

Get detailed information about a specific order.

Only the order owner or admin can access.

Process payment using Konnect (Tunisian gateway - TND).

**Payment Methods:** KONNECT, PAYMEE, STRIPE

**Returns:** `redirectUrl` to redirect user to payment page.

**Idempotency:** Provide `idempotencyKey` to prevent duplicate charges on retry.

Process payment using Stripe (international, EUR/USD).

**Returns:** `clientSecret` for Stripe.js to confirm on the frontend.

Process payment using Paymee (Tunisian gateway - TND).

**Returns:** `redirectUrl` to redirect user to payment page.

Request a refund for a paid order.

**Requirements:**
- Order must be in PAID status
- A reason must be provided

**Note:** Refund processing time depends on the payment gateway.

Send a notification to a user.

**Types:** ORDER_CONFIRMATION, TICKET_GENERATED, EVENT_REMINDER, EVENT_CANCELLED, TICKET_TRANSFER, PAYMENT_FAILED, WELCOME, PASSWORD_RESET

**Channels:** EMAIL, SMS, PUSH

**Priority:** LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, URGENT
Get the current user's notifications with pagination.
Get detailed information about a specific notification.
Get the current user's notification preferences.
Update the current user's notification preferences.

Unsubscribe from notifications via email link.

**No authentication required.**

**Categories:** `marketing`, `event_reminders`

item.name: 📊 Analytics
item.description: Event analytics, dashboards, revenue reports, and data export

request.description:
Get analytics for a specific event.

**Returns:** Total revenue, tickets sold, views, conversion rate, attendance metrics.

**Access:** Event owner or admin only.

Get the organizer's dashboard analytics.

**Time ranges:** `7d`, `30d`, `90d`

**Returns:** Summary metrics across all organizer events, top events, recent activity.

Get platform-wide analytics.

**Admin only.**

**Returns:** Total platform revenue, active users, events created, payment method breakdown, top organizers.

Get time series sales data for an event.

**Granularity:** `hour` or `day`

**Returns:** Array of data points with timestamp, ticket count, and revenue for each interval.

Get a revenue report for a date range.

**Returns:** Revenue breakdown by event, currency totals, commission earned, payment method distribution.

Generate and export an analytics report.

**Report Types:** `EVENT_REVENUE`, `PLATFORM_SUMMARY`, `TICKET_SALES`

**Formats:** `CSV`, `PDF`

**Returns:** `downloadUrl` — signed S3 URL to download the generated report.
